title: Auto-run mode deletes far more than the project
summary: Several Cursor users reported that an agent in auto-run (YOLO) mode ran recursive deletes that reached past the project: a neighbouring folder in one report, the home folder in others. One thread title quotes the command, a normal cleanup with the home folder added as one more argument. A security firm also showed that the built-in delete protections were easy to get around in that mode.
lesson: In auto-run mode the only thing between a typo and your home folder is a rule that reads the command. Have one.
